title: The Parser Accepted an Impossible Nesting
subject: Compilers
briefing: A parser's first validation pass checks whether an expression has balanced parentheses before building its syntax tree.
symptom: An expression with a closing parenthesis before its opener is accepted as balanced.
hints: Try an expression that begins with a closing parenthesis.
Equal counts at the end do not prove the nesting was valid along the way.
The nesting depth must never become negative while scanning from left to right.
